overview_description.description:
Tackle.io is a platform that helps software companies initiate revenue channels with the cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, GCP). Its platform simplifies the listing process and eliminates the need to dedicate engineers to learn and continually manage the technical aspects of the three cloud marketplaces.

Tackle.io was founded in 2016 by Brian Denker, Dillon Woods, and John Jahnke.

about_short_description.short_description: Tackle.io operates as a cloud marketplace subscription platform that helps software providers generate revenue.

product.name: Tackle Platform
product.description: A cloud marketplace subscription platform that integrates marketplace transactions, co-sell workflows, and cloud buyer intent data to support software providers in selling through cloud marketplaces.

product.name: Tackle Prospect
product.description: A tool that provides data on cloud buyers to help GTM teams identify and prioritize potential customers purchasing through cloud marketplaces.

product.name: Tackle Co-Sell
product.description: A solution that automates and manages co-selling workflows between software providers and cloud sellers across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft marketplaces.

product.name: Tackle Offers
product.description: A platform feature that enables software providers to list their products on cloud marketplaces and manage deal creation, tracking, and booking workflows.

product.name: Salesforce Integration
product.description: An integration that enables management of marketplace and co-sell operations directly within Salesforce for sales and revenue operations teams.

product.name: Strategic Services
product.description: Consulting and managed services including workshops, coaching, and operational support to help software providers develop and scale their cloud go-to-market strategies.
